title: Owner setup on NERV-01: the _nervjob user, the shared folder and the sudo rule
goal: The owner runs a copy-paste procedure once, with admin rights, and its expected result shows
acceptance: The procedure page names each command and its expected output: a hidden service user `_nervjob` (no password, no login, no home), `/Users/Shared/nerv-eva`, and a sudoers file allowing only `/usr/bin/sandbox-exec` and `/bin/kill` as `_nervjob`
`sudo -n -u _nervjob /usr/bin/true` is refused and `sudo -n -u _nervjob /bin/kill -0 -1` is allowed, as the page says
privacy: Neutral repository-owned fixtures only; no credentials, model calls or external effects in tests.
escalation: The machine is office-monitored: the owner decided to set it up and see whether it is noticed (2026-11-19)
